entities.summary: Andrew Patrick Stevenson is an American professional baseball outfielder who is a free agent. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Washington Nationals and Minnesota Twins, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Hokkaido Nippon-Ham Fighters and in the KBO League for the KT Wiz.
